title: A library entry stocked elsewhere is hidden when it matches an inactive part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations, the test location and location B, so a part can be stocked at location B only.
  • Have an inactive part, part A, at the test location, with a hyphen in its part number.
  • Create a part for this test at location B only whose number is part A's number with periods in place of its hyphens, number 1, so its Part Library entry matches part A.
  • Create a part for this test at location B only whose number matches nothing at the test location, number 2, so the Part Library has a row the search must still offer.
  • Give part A and the two location B parts descriptions that start with the same text, so one search finds all three.
  • Create an open work order, work order 1, for this test, with an approved line, line 1, that holds no parts.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click Add Part under line 1.
  2. Type the shared start of the descriptions in the Part Number field.
  3. Click the X at the top right of the window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Part Request window opens for line 1 of work order 1, with the Part Number field.

Step 2:

  • A "Part Library" row for number 2 is offered, which shows the search reached the Part Library.
  • Neither part A nor a "Part Library" row for number 1 is offered.

Step 3:

  • The window closes and line 1 holds no parts.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work), story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library)

  • S9-R15: “A Part Library entry with no part stocked at this location is not offered in the lookups of S9-R1 to S9-R8 when its number matches an inactive part at this location.”
  • Story 9, context note: “Context note: in S9-R9a, S9-R15, S9-R16 and S9-R17 a number "matches" an inactive part when the two are the same once upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces are ignored. A number that also belongs to an active part at this location is not refused.”
  • S12-R10: “A part lookup result that comes from the shared list shows its source as "Part Library".”
